PICKET 1.1 adds temporary voice channels for individual requests and operation deployments.

Members use `/picket voice` to choose officer-defined templates, add quantities to a private queue and deploy them together. No dedicated request channel is needed.

Officers configure up to 10 templates in `/picket settings`: category, channel name, capacity from 1 to 99 (default 99), and automatic cleanup after 1–30 continuously empty minutes (default 15). Deployments default to 6 channels, adjustable up to 10, with at most 15 open or reserved channels per server.

Tracking and confirmed requests survive restarts. Cleanup waits for reliable occupancy; ambiguous creations are not blindly repeated. The module uses the existing Gateway intents and does not request audit-log access or a voice connection. Server exports include template names only.

Server administrators should check **Manage Channels** and destination visibility on PICKET's role. The official installation defaults already include Manage Channels; existing category overrides may still prevent access.

Available in all six supported languages. See the [voice guide](https://docs.picket-foxhole.com/guide/voice) for setup, permissions and recovery limits.
